# Vendored lexicons

`com.atproto.repo.strongRef.json` is an unchanged copy of
[`lexicons/com/atproto/repo/strongRef.json`](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/blob/main/lexicons/com/atproto/repo/strongRef.json)
from [bluesky-social/atproto](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto), as it stood on 2026-11-25.
It is here so that validation runs offline. It is never edited here.
